raw_posts.name: Empacer
raw_posts.tagline: The voice-first assistant for small business owners
raw_posts.description: Most small business owners face the same problem when trying to use AI tools: they don't have time for re-explaining their business in every chat. Empacer is designed to skip this part. Three questions at setup, then spoken requests become a ready plan and finished work: customer replies, social posts, invoices and more. Nothing is sent without the owner's approval.

raw_posts.name: Scape
raw_posts.tagline: An intelligent email inbox that works for you
raw_posts.description: Imagine opening your inbox and finding everything already organized, with replies ready to review. Scape is an intelligent email client that prioritizes messages, prepares contextual drafts, and helps track conversations and follow-ups. It understands your work across emails, meetings, calendars, and attachments, so you can spend less time managing communication and more time moving work forward.

raw_posts.name: Floot in ChatGPT
raw_posts.tagline: Build and publish real apps without leaving ChatGPT
raw_posts.description: Floot is now a native app in your ChatGPT sidebar. Describe what you want, watch it build in a live preview inside the chat, and publish it with a real link. Database, logins and hosting are built in, and the AI runs on your ChatGPT plan.

raw_posts.tagline: Use claude code to build analytics widgets for your notch
raw_posts.description: Revenue, MRR and subscribers from Stripe, Polar, Paddle, Dodo Payments and more, in the MacBook notch.

raw_posts.name: Gologin Cloud Browser
raw_posts.tagline: Cloud browser for AI agents and tough sites
raw_posts.description: Gologin Cloud Browser gives AI agents and scrapers real Chromium browsers that stay logged in. Persistent sessions survive across runs, so there’s no re-auth or lost state. Built-in stealth and anti-bot protection, plus proxies in 150+ countries. Fully serverless, it scales to thousands of browsers and works with Playwright and Puppeteer via WebSocket. Built by the GoLogin team: 7 years’ expertise, SOC 2 Type II, 99.9% SLA. Plans from $4.50/mo.

raw_posts.name: Gemini 4 Carbon

raw_posts.name: TopAgent
raw_posts.tagline: Drive B2B event attendance with an AI agent
raw_posts.description: Fill your next B2B conference, summit, or workshop with SMS invitations and relevant follow-ups. Give TopAgent your opted-in audience, event details, registration link, and deadline. It prepares the campaign, monitors delivery, clicks, and replies, and returns with follow-ups ready for your approval.

raw_posts.name: Radar
raw_posts.tagline: You don't need an AI SRE. Give your agent Radar.
raw_posts.description: Your agent knows Kubernetes. It doesn't know your cluster. Radar (open-source) gives it context over MCP: ranked issues, a change timeline, logs and owners in one view. New: click Investigate on a failing workload. Claude Code, Codex or Cursor finds the root cause, read-only, with evidence for each claim. In our benchmark of 50 live faults across six tools, Radar found the most root causes. Radar Cloud investigates every alert and posts findings to Slack.

raw_posts.name: IFTTT.ai
raw_posts.tagline: The easiest way to automate anything
raw_posts.description: IFTTT is now IFTTT.ai, and every plan now includes our core features and all 1,000+ services, from multiple actions and filters to queries and Webhooks. Pricing is credit-based, and you can build unlimited Applets for free. AI got an upgrade too. AI Agent watches web pages for price changes or new listings, AI Action assist writes each action based on its trigger, and AI queries run on better models. Or describe an automation in IFTTT Chat and it builds the Applet for you.

raw_posts.name: Viggle JST-2
raw_posts.tagline: JST-2: 3D scenes, characters and motion from one model
raw_posts.description: JST-2 is Viggle’s physics-native world foundation model for generating 3D scenes, characters and full-body motion in one shared world. Scenes take about one second, characters come from one image or text with motion built in, and motion comes from text or video. Try it free in the PINOC browser app, or use the API or MCP with agents like Claude Code. Benchmarks are Viggle’s own blind human tests.
